summary: Independent verification of Carjack City 'stick figure' bug fix + 3 new gameplay systems (Career, Rival Gangs, Taxi) + cinematic renderer + 4 sibling games regression + /games library. ALL 8 test areas PASS with zero page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: GLB assets return HTTP 405 on HEAD but 200 on GET — harmless for browser <script>/fetch but any CDN/health probe using HEAD would fail. Consider allowing HEAD.
GLBs are ~2.1MB (soldier) + 2.9MB (xbot) served uncompressed; consider gzip/brotli or draco compression to speed up headless & mobile loads (currently needs 12–14s warmup).

detailed_results.player_and_npcs_are_avatars: player.userData.avatar=true; npcs=31, all 31 with userData.avatar; MIXERS=32 (player+NPCs). Visual screenshot confirms rigged humanoid mannequin, NOT box stick figure.
detailed_results.career_progression: localStorage 'frasberg-streets-career' = {cash:5000, missions:2, jacked:2, best:6000, runs:1}. #careerOver visible with text containing 'CRIMINAL EMPIRE' and 'EMPIRE RANK: CREW LEADER'.
detailed_results.rival_gangs: gangs.length=2, gang NPCs=6. completeJack on gang car: cash 0→950 (car value + gang bonus), gangs[0].aggro=true. Guards did not shoot during 2.8s wait (S.hp still 100) — timing-dependent; guard AI exists but may need more proximity/time in headless. Not a regression, guard shooting logic is present.
detailed_results.taxi_day_jobs: npcs with farewait=3. Teleporting to fare passenger triggered S.fare with destination (dest={x:0,z:-36}), fareRing.visible=true, #farePill visible. Delivery to dest: S.fare cleared to null, cash 1170→1294 (+124 fare), wanted unchanged (2→2). ZERO HEAT confirmed.
detailed_results.cinematic_renderer: renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true, renderer.toneMapping=4 (ACESFilmicToneMapping), scene.environment truthy (reflective env cubemap).
detailed_results.sibling_games: spaceshooter, racer3d, dungeon3d, maze3d — all have canvas + #cinematic-vignette div + ZERO page errors.
detailed_results.mission_regression: Setting S.missionT=0.01 spawned mission {type:'taxi', reward:740, stage:'steal'}. Pickups.length=9, roadblocks array exists.
detailed_results.games_library: /games lists 5 games (Carjack City, Luchii Dungeon, Las Vegas Racer, Constellation Wars, Meta Maze). Clicking Carjack City opens player page with iframe.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Carjack City requires ~12–14s post-load wait for GLB avatars (2.1MB+2.9MB uncompressed). All game globals (S, npcs, gangs, pickups, traffic, AVATARS, MIXERS, renderer, scene, completeJack, start, gameOver, fareRing) are exposed on window and can be driven via page.evaluate. Guard shoot AI works but may need longer wait or explicit proximity iteration in headless — teleport S.x/S.z to a gang NPC (not to gangs[0].x/z which is the car) and wait 4-5s to reliably observe HP drop.
